scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.db:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run db:demo -w backend
scripts.db:reset-demo: npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset-demo -w backend
